title: Verify watchdog persistence restart and guardian behavior
limitations: Restarting the loop and the supervisor reloads watchdog/state.json and watchdog/restart-journal.json. The same in-flight action stays the only writer. A lower attempt count, an earlier cooldown, a dropped action, or a missing sealed HOLD, STOP, or OPERATOR_STOP marker is refused.
The journal records counters only when the loop state file is already present at publish. Resume still requires that file. A later higher counter is kept. Restart does not charge another attempt.

The optional guardian renders a user unit and starts only worldwide-legal-search-watchdog.service. It does not install or enable the unit. A hold marker, a foreign unit, a live main process, or three starts inside 1800 seconds refuse the start. A refused start does not spend the budget. A start that is attempted stays charged when systemctl fails.
The rendered unit uses /usr/bin/python3.12. Tests inject systemctl show and start. They do not contact the operator's user systemd or write the operator's home unit.

The sealed interpreter /usr/bin/python3.12 does not provide pytest on the authoritative PATH. The restart suite was executed with the workspace virtualenv that provides pytest 9.1.1. A later local repeat of the same argv exited 0 with 12 skips whose reason was pytest AST seal matches.
This receipt does not grant campaign completion or task completion.
